item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Nesat will move towards the vicinity of Beibu Wan and weaken gradually in the next couple of days. Besides, an area of low pressure east of the Philippines may develop further, and enter the South China Sea over the weekend to early next week. However, there are still uncertainties in its intensity.
